title: Oitij-jo x Whitechapel Gallery
intro: Join the Whitechapel Gallery for an evening programme of music, film and food curated by Oitij-jo, following a day of performances and workshops celebrating British Bengali arts and culture on Petticoat Lane. sections.text: This event takes place in Gallery 2 at Whitechapel Gallery, a ground floor space.
